messages:
jordan: CI nightly e2e perf gate failed on longseq — p95 +18% vs baseline. Job: https://ci.redwood/tests/longseq-nightly/2897. Blocked on deploy. @riley @sophia can one of you take a quick look?
ci-bot: Job longseq-nightly #2897 failed: perf_gate (p95_latency) exceeded threshold (18.4% increase). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2897
riley: On it. grabbing logs now. can you paste the perf summary?
jordan: summary:
```
baseline p95: 120ms
current p95: 142ms
delta: +18.3%
workload: mixed-longseq (seq_len 2048)
```
also noticed more KV cache misses in the run vs baseline.
akshay: fyi PRs merged last 6h: #4119 (kv-cache refactor), #4127 (sched tweak), #4130 (bench harness change). KV change seems suspect.
sophia: can we rerun with kvcache disabled (ENV: REDWOOD_KVCACHE=off) for a quick check? if that fixes it we can bisect #4119.
riley: kicked off targeted run w/ kvcache=off: jenkins/ci-targeted/longseq/2900. pinging when done. ETA ~5m
ci-bot: Run 2900 completed: p95: 121ms (+0.8%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2900
riley: looks like disabling kvcache brings latency back. confirmed suspect = kvcache refactor. assigning bisect.
akshay: I'll bisect between commits a1b2c3..d4e5f6 for #4119. starting binary search.
jordan: should we hold deploy until rollback or patch? release has 2 PRs today.
sophia: prefer patch revert of the refactor. can we revert the minimal change that affected cache eviction? if bisect points to a specific commit I can prepare a rollback PR.
akshay: bisect found culprit commit d2d4f (kv eviction edge-case). opening revert PR: #4135. riley can you run quick smoke?
riley: ran smoke on revert PR #4135: jenkins/merge-checks/2910 -> p95 119ms. good. I'm tagging for rollback. @ops please pause today's deploy.
ops-bot: Deploys paused for release-2026-03-17 per request from @riley. Notifying oncall.
jordan: thanks team. label followups: add regression test for KV edge-case, add guard in future refactors. I'll make a ticket.
riley: :thumbsup:
